result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated and strongly aligned with the methods used, which are detailed enough for reproducibility.

objective_evidence.quote: We investigated whether SARS-CoV-2 protein or ribonucleic acid (RNA) persists in placental tissue months after maternal COVID-19 infection.

method_evidence.quote: This case-control study was conducted and reported in accordance with the Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) reporting guideline.
